svg.text: INGESTION
Synthetic Data Generator
Cloud Run Job, scheduled every 15 min via Cloud Scheduler
Publishes synthetic patient readings (vitals + free-text report notes) to Pub/Sub
Topic: patient-telemetry-raw, with a dead-letter topic (5 delivery attempts)
STREAM PROCESSING
Dataflow · Apache Beam Flex Template
parse / validate -> DE-IDENTIFY free-text notes (Cloud DLP, inline) -> route
Writes every event to BOTH stores below, independently — no export step
Private workers, no public IP (org policy); dependencies baked into the image
CLINICAL STORE
Cloud Healthcare API — FHIR R4 store
Patient · Observation · DiagnosticReport
ANALYTICS STORE
BigQuery: observations, diagnostic_reports, risk_assessments, patients
dashboard_* views — never select the policy-tagged columns
Policy tags (Data Catalog) · Data Access audit logs · CMEK default key
INTELLIGENCE
risk-insight-processor · Cloud Run Job, every 15 min
BigQuery ML logistic regression -> ml_risk_score (0.0 – 1.0) per patient
Gemini 2.5 Flash (Vertex AI, google-genai SDK) -> plain-language explanation
Writes risk_assessments; risk_level from the score: high >= 0.7, medium >= 0.4
ALERTING
Cloud Run Job, scheduled every 15 min
High-risk assessments -> HTML email via the Gmail API
(OAuth)
Token cached in Secret Manager
CLINICIAN PORTAL
Cloud Run, ingress locked to the load balancer
HTTPS LB + IAP + Cloud Armor + managed cert, custom
domain
/ patient list /patient/{id} vitals + AI insight /analytics dashboard
PARTNER-CLINIC API
Cloud Run
API key (Secret Manager) + IAM-restricted
GET /patients/{id}/telemetry · OpenAPI spec at /docs
PLATFORM & DELIVERY
spans everything above
Terraform — 15 modules, GCS remote state | GitHub Actions + Workload Identity Federation (keyless)
Plan on every push, destroy-guarded manual apply | Secret Manager | Cloud KMS | Cloud Monitoring
